title: Collect Your Bounty
description: The rise is Thornfield's again. Report to the captain, who still hasn't the men to keep it held.

objectives.description: Report the lookout retaken to the guard captain

notes: Closing beat states the unresolved problem plainly: the position is retaken but the garrison is still short, so the fix does not outlast the player's involvement. Consequence of a future refusal to help again is implied, not wired.
